name: Humanity
summary: Humanity Schedule costs $2.75 per employee a month on Essentials for up to 250 employees and starts at $3.75 on Professional, both billed annually, with a 30-day Professional trial. Enterprise is quoted. The monthly billing price is not shown on the pricing page.

facts.text: TCP Software states that all prices on its website and payments are in USD.
Professional pricing starts at $3.75 per employee a month and the page notes volume discounts may apply.
TCP provides SOC 2 Type II reports only to customers, prospects and partners under a mutual non-disclosure agreement, and lists public SOC 3 reports including one for Humanity Schedule.
Humanity holds TX-RAMP Level 2 certification, with an expiration date of March 7, 2027 on the security page.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually; volume discounts may apply

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows a monthly billing option with a 20% annual saving but does not list the monthly price.
